text: Confirmed: the engine holds 2 BoltOdds keys, and BoltOdds now answers on GitHub (lines and props both returning games, no more 429s). I also read boltodds.com/docs against the code: it already handles every message (game_update, line_update, game_removed, sport_clear/book_clear, resubscribe wait, snapshot only at start/reconnect, auto-reconnect), so nothing else was missing.
